events.statement: A contemporaneous record reports that the Administrador Concursal had spoken with Javier Rubio Sanz of Uría Menéndez. This does not by itself establish representation, conflict or improper information flow.

Preserved RICPE presentation materials describe Uría Menéndez Madrid and PwC in the project-processing/due-diligence architecture and attribute to José Acosta statements including 'libres de cargas' and Sun Park / €12m. Those statements are not independent proof of title or absence of charges.

RICPE certification describes Sun Park as at a very early study/negotiation stage and says complete legal, tax, financial, technical and insurance due diligence had not yet taken place because no letter of intent had been signed.
CAM filing supplies the RICPE certification into the relevant documentary record.

The recovered consolidated pre-filing version requests reports/notes from Uría Menéndez, PwC and others concerning title, encumbrances, suitability, risks and the real scope of Sun Park in 2020–2021. The Decanato receipt documents reception/submission on 9 July 2026 but does not independently establish byte-for-byte identity between the recovered DOCX and the physically filed document.
